scope: Entire independent 16-run/1024-position/five-arm saved computational evidence, with complete native identity/QED/stock/full-ranking checks

saved_native_routes.scope: Complete 16-run/1024-position/5120-row saved-route, qualification, prefix, exact-origin and work audit

saved_CPU: No native RF, attribution model, reaction, Graph or external predictor was executed by this audit. Historical raw RF feedback canonicalization is explicitly counted additional descriptor audit work.
Version metadata and original fixed paths are compatibility evidence; model/template content bytes were not compared.
Source/candidate stock/QED/canonicalization and full stock ranking require the separate native descriptor audit.
Saved attribution prediction/permutation/rank arithmetic is checked; underlying tree-path contribution magnitudes are not independently recomputed without the forest.
Native RF probabilities and positive-class indices are checked against durable request/completion records. The forest class metadata or model weights are not independently loaded.
Complete saved native root products establish provenance, not independent enumeration of every retro match or forward correctness.
Original remote timestamps establish temporal order; relocated backups may have different file modification times and are not interchangeable for this check.
Passing saved-record checks establishes no biological activity, laboratory synthesis or efficacy endpoint; route/external audits are separate.
native_CPU_properties: This is additional descriptor/stock matching audit CPU work, not an efficacy experiment or repeated scientific inference.
Source tree-path attribution magnitudes are saved values. Their downstream Morgan grouping and full stock ranking arithmetic were independently recomputed; the forest was not loaded.
SMARTS reactant queries were parsed, but native reactions and original root enumeration were not rerun.
Recorded products are checked for enrollment, QED and stock identity; independent synthesis chemistry, biological activity, route witnesses and ten-checkpoint endpoints are outside this audit.
saved_native_routes: Saved native route topology, root identity, stock leaves, target exclusion and retained audit semantics are verified; no reaction prediction was repeated.
Source/candidate RF values and QED are preserved measurements; this route audit does not rerun forests, forward chemistry, attribution, or the RF feature/descriptor runtime.
Exact asset paths and native runtime versions are checked; model checkpoint contents are not independently authenticated or repredicted.
Incomplete physical observations retain unknown endpoints and unknown upper cost bounds even if a partial graph contains a route.
Historical entries without embedded target_role require actual original parent input metadata or original candidate-attempt references; no missing historical role label is invented.
External predicted-task endpoint arithmetic and independent-run statistics require their separate audit. Native saved routes do not establish laboratory synthesis or activity.
saved_endpoints: Released checkpoint declaration, exact saved origin vectors, compatible feature/runtime versions and conflicts are checked; no weights were repredicted or independently authenticated.
Older fold files without model-reference headers require actual saved study metadata plus an exact aggregate binding; absent evidence fails the audit rather than inventing metadata.
Saved chemical profiles are bound to their physical descriptor cache without recalculating descriptors. Canonical provenance keys must match saved canonical identities.
The separate native route audit proves saved route/stock/decision semantics; this script does not establish laboratory synthesis or biological activity.
Sixteen optimizer runs, conditional on two fixed tasks/assets, are the inference units. Repeated positions, repeated products and ten checkpoints are not independent experiments.
The sole primary is B fixed minus B strict. Secondary comparisons are exploratory and cannot replace an unsupported primary.
Technical unknowns retain paired identification bounds only; operational source fallbacks do not become observed final-policy properties.
A within-task 100000-run bootstrap is calculated once and saved by its actual paired effects/seed; it is a sensitivity interval, not independent new scientific evidence.
